scientific_role: complete the frozen v111 learned-advantage gate after independently validated Formal Stage A

data_and_split.normalization: identical to the v111 parent: current-frame observation RMS only

cnn_training.loss_terms_and_weights: identical to the frozen v111 formal fit
cnn_training.fit_only_checkpoint_selection: identical nested worst trajectory-by-geometry eight-gate ordering to v111
cnn_training.seed_rule: all three seeds are trained and reported separately; no best-seed selection or ensemble

controls.family: deterministic fit-only reference-chart PCA projected ridge followed by unchanged CGLS K1
controls.basis: fold-local PCA of supported zero-mean reference truth from the four fit trajectories and ten training frames; maps and geometries do not duplicate truth rows
controls.coefficient_guard: closed standardized ball fitted only to fold-local truth coefficients
controls.deployment: known map pushes the fold-local mean and modes once; known geometry projects them offline; deployment solves the fixed ridge system from observation only

controls.family: deterministic fit-only reference-chart PCA projected ridge followed by unchanged CGLS K1
controls.basis: same fold-local truth basis construction as rank4, retaining the first 32 modes
controls.deployment: same observation-only projected solve and unchanged K1
controls.role: strong projected-ridge capacity stress; this arm defines the primary projected-ridge comparison

controls.family: v29-style causal three-dimensional CNN followed by unchanged CGLS K1
the 42237-parameter v111 backbone with every explicit map channel replaced by exact zeros
the 42237-parameter v111 backbone with every camera token replaced by exact zeros

scoring.cell_roster: the same 990 heldout trajectory-by-map-by-geometry-by-frame cells per seed as v111
scoring.dominance: an equal-or-lower exact-call control dominates a candidate seed only if it passes the same trajectory gates and is no worse on every frozen trajectory-equal summary component with at least one strict improvement
scoring.paired_better_fraction_definition: for each candidate seed and parent control separately, compute the fraction of all 990 paired heldout cells for which the candidate error is strictly lower than the control error
scoring.trajectory_equal_p90_and_worst_definitio: for every heldout trajectory and each of the four metrics, the candidate seed p90-higher and worst must be no greater than the paired parent control values
scoring.early_fail_rule: if any equal-or-lower exact-call parent control passes the same Stage A trajectory gates and rejects learned advantage by dominance or by the frozen paired/tail contract, stop before training or scoring any larger model

noninterference.prediction_worker_inputs: deployment bundle plus frozen checkpoint or fold-local projected-ridge artifact only
noninterference.heldout_label_mutation: after all predictions are sealed, replace heldout truth arrays in an independent scoring copy with large finite sentinel values and require every prediction byte to remain identical

decision.if_pass: authorize only a separately frozen fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate
decision.if_fail: retain the strongest simple control and close the DRC-Warm learned-advantage claim; do not rescue with FNO, UNO or a larger U-Net
